props.label: External Id
props.description: This is the external completion or build record ID passed back from NetSuite. You may have the same completion ID linked to multiple production history records as part of the work order process close out routine. If production is from a Work Order this should be a WO Completion (with or without backflush - based on process) if a Lean Card this should be an Assembly Build (with or without backflush)
